about: What bb tool office runs: LibreOffice without a window, to turn documents, decks and spreadsheets into PDFs. About 750 MB.
label: LibreOffice, headless
name: office

run: dst="$2"; t="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$dst/bin"; cp "$1" "$t/lo.AppImage"; chmod +x "$t/lo.AppImage"; (cd "$t" && ./lo.AppImage --appimage-extract >/dev/null); rm -rf "$dst/lo"; mv "$t/squashfs-root" "$dst/lo"; so="$(find "$dst/lo/opt" -maxdepth 3 -path '*/program/soffice' | head -1)"; test -x "$so"; ln -sf "../${so#"$dst"/}" "$dst/bin/soffice"; rm -rf "$t"
